text:
anna: Heads-up — p95 spiked ~40ms on small-req traffic after we increased the coalesce window for cost savings. Can we chew on SLO-aware coalesce thresholds + a tenant leasing idea?

ben: ugh, saw that on the dashboard too. link: https://grafana.redwood/rd/boards/req-coalesce (p95 went 160->200ms last 2h)

carlos: quick thought: instead of a single global coalesce window, we could have SLO buckets. tenants with strict p95 get tighter windows + short leases that avoid eviction churn.

deepti: define "lease" here? you mean a short-running affinity that pins a tenant's microqueue to a worker for X ms?

carlos: yeah. e.g. lease_duration_ms=200 by default for low-latency tenants; renew only on activity. avoids repeated preempt/rehydrate cycles.

ben: config sketch: ```
# slo-aware coalesce
coalesce.global_max_wait_ms=12
coalesce.slo_bucket_strict_max_wait_ms=6
lease.default_ms=200
lease.renew_on_activity=true
```

anna: nice. telemetry we should capture: p50/p95/p99 per slo_bucket, coalesced_batch_size histogram, lease_acquire_failures, lease_renew_rate, kv_cache_eviction_rate.

runtime-bot: deploy-bot: rolled coalesce-window experiment to canary (canary=us-east-1-a) at 2026-03-21T10:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

ben: also watch headroom: smaller windows -> smaller batch sizes -> higher GPU utilization per-token. need to model cost tradeoffs.

deepti: agree. propose AB test: 10% traffic strict-slo policy, 45% baseline, 45% cost-optimized. Run for 48h, baseline workload. Success criteria: strict p95 <= target (180ms) and overall token-cost delta < 5%.

carlos: streaming note: if we tighten windows for strict tenants, streaming responses might see more flush events. need to special-case streaming flows (disable leases? or extend lease_ms for streaming).

anna: good call. streaming flag: coalesce.disable_for_streaming=true by default for strict bucket.

ben: add fallback: if host-level p95 exceeds threshold for 3m, auto-shrink coalesce window by 30% and increase preemptive_flush_rate. That gives graceful degradation.

deepti: i'll own the experiment run and dashboard panels. will add alerts: (p95_strict > target) || (coalesced_batch_size_median < 2 && token-cost-up > 10%).

carlos: one more risk: lease churn can increase KV cache misses if we move tenants around frequently. we should collect kvcache.miss_rate by tenant during the test.

anna: agreed. if kvcache.miss_rate increases > 15% for strict tenants, abort and revert.

runtime-bot: test-harness: AB test started (id ab-1748889999) - traffic splits applied. ETA 48h.

ben: can we instrument a synthetic low-latency probe to each worker to measure background coalesce impact? quick ping every 30s to get stable baseline.

deepti: will add synthetic probes + per-worker qlen/avg_batch_size metrics.

anna: perfect. next step: write a short RFC (problem, knobs, telemetry, abort criteria, rollout plan) — want it by EOD so engineering can sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:

carlos: I'll draft the lease semantics section and potential concurrency pitfalls.

ben: i'll write the cost model piece.

deepti: i'll own the experiment infra + dashboards.

anna: thanks team — ping here when RFC is up.
